description:
→ “Best app for sleep” – Reviewed.com
→ Named Apple’s "App of the Day" over 65 times
→ “The most positively reviewed app in the history of the Apple Store” – Business Insider

Relax Melodies is now BetterSleep. It’s the same great app with all the sounds and content you know and love but with a new sleep tracker, sleep recorder and a beautiful new layout. 
Sleep better. Feel better.

BetterSleep helps you understand and improve your sleep with its easy-to-use sleep tracker, sleep recorder, premium sleep sounds, amazing stories and soothing guided meditations. Doesn't that sound dreamy?
Leading doctors, neuropsychologists, and sleep experts recommend BetterSleep . . . and 91% of our listeners say they slept better after using the app for just one week.

Premium Audio Content
Fall asleep easily, sleep soundly, and develop lasting sleep habits, with dreamy soundscapes, narrated sleep stories, hypnosis and meditations that really work, all perfectly tuned to your needs.

Sleep Tracker
Track your sleep, understand how it works and let us propose actionable ways to improve it.

Sleep Recorder 
Record the sounds you make while you sleep and listen to them when you wake up. BetterSleep identifies when you snore, move around, sleep talk and make other common sounds at night. 

Sleep Science
Learn about the science behind your unique sleep needs and discover your personal chronotype.

More than 300 sleep sounds & music tracks:

Also featuring:

Bedtime reminders: Set one every night for more restful sleep
Timers: Stop the app after a set amount of time
Favorites: A section to add your favorite mixes
Playlist: Select your favorite content and create your sleep-inducing playlist
Smart Mix: Make distracting audio loops disappear and enjoy seamless sound mixes

...and lots more!

BetterSleep optionally integrates with the HealthKit to track your sleep

BetterSleep offers in-app purchases including auto-renewable subscriptions to access premium features
